_about: One entry per medium for the studio's instruments. Facts and sources in docs/MEDIA.md; finishing operations in docs/FINISHING.md. absorbency and tooth are 0-1 engine parameters (starting values for tuning). Source ids refer to docs/MEDIA.md#sources.

media.name: oil
media.binder: drying oil (linseed, walnut, poppy); dries by oxidation
media.opacity: transparent to opaque by pigment; glazes transparent, whites and earths opaque

canvas_linen.texture: fine irregular weave under acrylic or oil gesso

canvas_toned.texture: weave under a thin transparent earth imprimatura

panel_gesso.texture: smooth sanded gesso panel; every stroke edge shows

tools.round: tapered point; line to blob with pressure
tools.flat: long square-edged hair; planes and chisel edges
tools.bright: short stiff flat; short thick dabs
tools.filbert: flat with rounded tip; soft-edged leaf-shaped marks
tools.fan: sparse spread hairs; foliage, hair, softening
tools.rigger: very long thin hair; long even lines
tools.knife: flat slabs, crisp edges, scraped passages
tools.rag: wipes out lights toward the ground
tools.blender: soft dry brush or finger; softens edges
tools.scraper: sgraffito into wet paint, reveals ground

order_of_work: thin lean block-in or monochrome underpainting
colour layers, each fatter than the last
finishing: finish retouch (after 2-3 months for normal layers)
finish varnish gloss=G (when dry throughout, ~1 year)
signatures: uneven gloss where passages sank in

media.name: watercolour

hot_press.texture: smooth, pressed with heated rollers; paint stays on surface, sharp edges, lifts well

cold_press.texture: felt-roller tooth that grips paint; granulation and soft edges

rough.texture: pronounced texture; fast absorption, strong granulation, hard to detail

tools.round: main brush; holds water, comes to a point; hairline to broad by pressure
tools.mop: large soft belly; even washes and wet-in-wet skies
tools.hake: wide flat goat-hair brush for laying washes
tools.rigger: long hair for branches and long lines
tools.clean_damp_brush: adds water: lifts lines, causes blooms in damp washes
tools.masking_fluid: reserves white shapes with hard edges
tools.salt: pulls water into small pale starry spots in a damp wash

signatures: back-runs / blooms with branching dark edges
white of paper as the light

media.name: ink
media.binder: animal glue (East Asian soot ink stick); gum arabic (Western carbon, iron gall, bistre)
media.opacity: dense carbon black when full strength; transparent grey washes when diluted

xuan_raw.texture: unsized absorbent fibrous paper; ink feathers and bleeds

xuan_sized.texture: alum-and-glue sized xuan; crisp lines for gongbi

silk.texture: sized silk with fine weave, warm tone

tools.brush_chinese: conical tuft with belly reservoir; tip dark, belly watery; pressure swells the line
tools.brush_side: oblique brush; broad stroke, sharp on one side, ragged on the other
tools.pen_nib: flexible steel nib; line swells with pressure
tools.pen_reed: broad blunt reed; direction-dependent width, gritty

signatures: flying white (feibai) in fast dry strokes
feathery bleeding into raw xuan with darker rim

media.name: charcoal
media.opacity: opaque dust; tone set by coverage of the paper

laid_drawing.texture: Ingres-type laid lines that show in every tone

watercolour_140lb.texture: cold-press texture that makes interesting broken marks

toned_grey.texture: mid-grey drawing paper for working with white chalk

tools.vine_side: broad pale band broken by tooth
tools.compressed_tip: dense rich black line, harder to erase
tools.chamois: wide soft smear, knocks back tone
tools.kneaded: dabbed lifts, soft highlights; tone by pressure

order_of_work: tone the paper or start white
block in big shapes and tones quickly
refine with harder sticks or pencils

media.name: graphite
media.opacity: opaque particles; tone by coverage; darkest is a mid-dark grey

tools.pencil_9H_to_9B: grade sets hardness and darkness; point gives narrow even line
tools.pencil_side: broad tone with a soft grade
tools.hatch: parallel strokes building tone; second pass for cross-hatching
tools.stylus: indented lines that stay white under later tone

order_of_work: light construction with a hard grade

media.name: pastel
media.binder: minimal (soft pastel); non-drying oil and wax (oil pastel variant)
media.opacity: opaque particles but broken over tooth; underlayers show through

toned_laid.texture: Ingres-type laid toned paper; modest tooth

pulp_rough.texture: inexpensive machine-made wood-pulp paper with rough texture (Degas)

tools.hard_pastel_side: broad early masses broken by tooth
tools.workable_fix: restores tooth between layers, darkens slightly
tools.solvent_brush: dissolves oil pastel into a wash

order_of_work: big masses with sides of hard pastels
dark to light, hard to soft

media.name: gouache
media.binder: gum arabic (higher pigment load, often chalk or titanium white opacifier)

tools.flat: flat even fields and crisp edges

media.name: tempera
media.opacity: translucent to opaque by layering; thin layers

panel_gesso.texture: rigid wood panel, glue size, several coats of gesso sanded smooth

gold_ground.texture: water-gilt gold leaf over bole, burnished, with punchwork

tools.small_round: small soft sable, nearly dry; thin hatched strokes
tools.hatch: short parallel and cross-hatched strokes following form
tools.gild: lays gold leaf over bole in a region

order_of_work: flesh tones in several premixed values

media.name: fresco
media.binder: none (lime carbonation fixes pigment in wet intonaco); binder for secco
media.opacity: thin transparent washes building to chalky opaque

intonaco.texture: fresh lime plaster over rough arriccio, painted in daily giornate

tools.secco_brush: bound paint on dry plaster for details

media.name: woodblock

washi_sized.texture: kozo-fibre washi sized with dosa; fibres visible; printed damp

tools.carve_key: keyblock: brushed lines left raised, keeping brush taper
tools.ink_block: brush colour into the wood grain with hake; nori for even spread
tools.bokashi: graded wiping of colour into water on the block

order_of_work: print lightest colours first, darker on top
